异议、离心还是效忠：精英的选择
Dissent, Disaffection, or Loyalty: Elite Choices
前面各章考察的问题，都对政府同精英的关系有重要影响，无论是原有的精英，还是七、八世纪逐渐兴起的精英。这也引出了本书所要谈及的最重要的问题之一。我们已经看到，晚期罗马精英尽管内部多样，且高度区域化，却是晚期罗马文学文化的承载者，也守护着早先的罗马和希腊化世界以城市为中心的文化传统。
七世纪，城市作用发生变化，对波斯的战争，尤其是对阿拉伯人的战争，又使帝国蒙受巨大的领土损失。这些变化在许多方面都影响了这项传统。
如第一章所述，晚期罗马文学文化的若干显著特征几乎完全消失，与之消失的还有它所承载的大部分文化资本。文化和思想的视野收窄，旧元老阶层，连同与之相联的相当一部分文学文化遗产，在七世纪渐渐消退。继之而起的是新的精英阶层。这一阶层以任职效力为基础，族群、社会和文化出身各异，当然也吸纳了许多旧精英成员，尤其是在首都地区和教会高层。

即便如此，这一阶层所代表的，还是与先前颇不相同的东西。帝国政治生活、仕途与地位向来围绕君士坦丁堡运转，但东部行省丧失后，君士坦丁堡的中心地位更为突出。安纳托利亚和巴尔干南部的聚落形式和城市生活发生转变，东罗马国家领土缩小，亚历山大里亚和奥龙特斯河畔安条克等国际性大都市也已丧失。这意味着，如今只有君士坦丁堡能成为取得财富、地位和权力的中心。这里是帝国的统治中心、帝国宫廷的所在地，也是帝国保有的城市中最大的一座，如今成了人们投入社会资本的唯一中心。无论谋求首都还是各行省的职位，君士坦丁堡都是唯一的途径。教会提供了一条与此相当的仕进途径，但它的中心也在君士坦丁堡，由该城的主教，也就是牧首主持。皇帝、宫廷与教会比以往任何时候都更是社会晋升的主要凭藉。取得权力的途径虽还有很多支路，并不直接卷入这个关系网，但占主导地位的入仕门路还是这几条，尤其是通过帝国宫廷。

The issues reviewed in the previous chapters all had important implications for the relationship between the government and the elite, both the established elements and those elements that evolved during the seventh and eighth centuries, and this brings me to one of the most important issues that this book will touch upon. As we have now seen, the late Roman elite, internally diverse and highly regionalized though it was, was the bearer of late Roman literary culture and the guardian of the urban-centered cultural traditions of the earlier Roman and Hellenistic worlds.
The changes of the seventh century— changes in the role of cities, the huge losses of imperial territory that the Persian and especially the Arab wars ushered in— affected this in many ways.

As we noted in Chapter 1, a number of key identifying aspects of late Roman literary culture vanish almost completely, along with much of the cultural capital it carried with it. Cultural and ideological horizons become narrower, and the older senatorial establishment, with much of the literary cultural baggage associated with it, faded away during the seventh century. Instead there develops a new elite, a service elite of heterogeneous ethnic, social, and cultural origins, certainly incorporating many elements of the older establishment, especially in the metropolitan region and in the senior church hierarchy,

but nevertheless representing something rather different from what had gone before. Imperial political life, career, and status had always revolved around Constantinople, but as the eastern provinces were lopped off, the Constantinopolitan focus became even more pronounced. The transformations in settlement patterns and urban life in Anatolia and the southern Balkans along with the territorial reduction of the eastern Roman state and the loss of the great international urban centers such as Alexandria and Antioch on the Orontes meant that now only Constantinople could serve as a focus for acquiring wealth, status, and power. As the seat of empire, home of the imperial court, and the largest city remaining to the empire, it was now the only focus for the investment of social capital. Whether seeking a post in the metropolis or in the provinces, Constantinople was the only option. The church provided an alternative and equivalent career structure, but even the church, in the form of the bishop of Constantinople, the patriarch, had its focus there. The emperor, the court, and the church became, more than ever before, the sources par excellence of social advancement. And while there were many minor routes to power that were not directly pulled into that nexus, it was these, and the imperial court in particular, that nevertheless constituted the dominant mode of entry.
要属于这个罗马精英的世界，须具备一定的读写能力，其水平无疑会随出身、背景和受教育机会而有很大差异，并须以某种方式参与既有的文学文化。还须全然承认以上帝选立的皇帝为最高权威的罗马帝国体制，并按个人的社会、经济与文化资本所允许的层级，成为国家或教会建制的一员。九世纪初写作的编年史家狄奥凡尼斯，对“成为罗马人”的定义十分简单，即通晓希腊人的文字和语言，接受罗马政体的习俗和传统。
基督教信仰，尤其是正统的基督教信仰，则被视为理所当然。不论在行省，还是在首都与宫廷，成为社会文化与政治精英的一员，也就意味着成为这个意义上的罗马人。

The hallmarks of belonging to this elite Roman world were a degree of literacy (no doubt very variable according to origins, background, and educational opportunity) and participation in the established literary culture in some way; an absolute acceptance of the Roman imperial system with the God-appointed emperor at the apex; and membership of the state or church establishment at whatever level an individual’s social, economic, and cultural capital permitted. The chronicler Theophanes, writing in the early ninth century, defines “becoming Roman” quite simply as knowing the letters and language of the Greeks and accepting the ways and traditions of the Roman polity.

Christianity, and more particularly orthodox Christianity, was taken for granted. Being a member of the sociocultural and political elite, whether in the provinces or the capital and at court, meant also being a Roman in this sense.

很清楚，政府如果得不到行省精英的配合与积极支持，就无法指望维持在行省的权威，也就无法提取所需的财政资源。这既要求观念上的共识，也要求政治上的务实。许多研究表明，无论是疆域广阔的帝国，还是地理上相当紧凑的政体，要控制征服之地，首先就得确保各地精英的忠诚。除了除掉并替换原有精英，例如诺曼人在1066年击败哈罗德之后大体做成的那样，别无多少选择，不过确保其忠诚的方法有许多。强制一时行得通，但整个体制要长久维持，归根结底，中央与行省、统治精英与行省精英之间就必须有一定程度的利益互惠。新近征服或兼并的领土与那里原先居于统治地位的精英如此，历史悠久的贵族或其他支配社会的群体，也是如此。

特别就罗马帝国而言，有研究清楚地表明，罗马统治之所以未遭到普遍的叛乱和反抗，并非因为被征服地区的民众据说最终认同了罗马国家及其价值观。绝大多数民众对此并无多少发言权。为了确保罗马的支配地位，统治者吸纳地方精英，在文化上（主要是语言上）和政治上使他们融入罗马的统治机构，而该机构也能直接以强力施加权威。这并不排除被征服地区一般民众最终出现同化或认同。在一定层次和某些地区，这显然发生过。例如在西部，拉丁语的各种方言在语言上逐渐形成并传播；在帝国东部，从六世纪后期和七世纪起，人们共同拥护帝国教会及罗马国家，虽有此前讨论的种种地方差异。这个过程从来就不简单，但显然，促成罗马统治稳定并使之长久延续的，主要是行省精英在思想和政治上被纳入了罗马的统治集团。

It is clear that the government could not hope to maintain its authority in the provinces, and thus extract the fiscal resources it needed, without the collaboration and active support of provincial elites. And that implied both ideological consensus as well as pragmatic politics. Many studies have shown that states, whether far-flung imperial systems or geographically compact polities, must before all else secure the loyalty of their various local elites if they are to retain control over the conquered lands— short of eradicating the former elite and replacing them (as the Normans did more or less effectively after the defeat of Harold in 1066), there are few alternatives, although there have been many means of achieving this end. Coercion can work for a time, but in the end some degree of reciprocity between center and province, between ruling elite and provincial elites, is essential if the system is to survive over any length of time. This holds not only in the case of newly conquered or absorbed territories and their formerly dominant elites but also where old established aristocracies or dominant social groups are concerned.

In the case of the Roman Empire in particular, it has been shown very clearly that it was not some supposed eventual identification of the populations in the conquered territories with the Roman state and its values that explained the absence of rebellion and opposition on a systemic basis to Roman rule— the vast mass of the population had little say in the matter. Rather, Roman hegemony was secured by co-opting local elites and by assimilating them both culturally (primarily linguistically) and politically into the Roman governing establishment, with its ability to impose authority through direct physical coercion. This is not to suggest that no assimilation or identification of the broader masses of the conquered populations might not or did not eventually take place because at certain levels and in certain areas it clearly did— linguistically, for example, in the evolution and spread of various dialects of Latin in the west, or in the case of the eastern parts of the empire from the later sixth and seventh centuries on, through a common adherence to the imperial church and the Roman state (even with all the local variations we have discussed). This was never a straightforward process, but it is clear that it was above all the ideological and political incorporation of provincial elites into a Roman establishment that contributed toward the stabilization and indeed the longevity of Roman rule.

不过，行省精英对一个遥远政府的忠诚，其实对任何政府的忠诚，都以国家保护自身利益为条件，也取决于国家能否有效地以某种方式惩处挑战或不支持其权威的人。对帝国中央产生离心或敌意，是因为地方精英所认定的自身既得利益，同国家利益不再契合。纵观历史，精英在维护自身利益上格外一贯，无论需要为此作出什么妥协。比如430年代汪达尔人到来之后，北非精英几乎没有为捍卫当地教会及教士的利益做任何事，他们宁愿保全自己的利益。这种反应显示，他们在观念上的忠诚相当不稳固，也凸显了精英社会以自身利益为先的特点。不同时代与社会中，这类例子还可以举出许多。
这样的表现已是一个迹象。即使在那之前的几十年里还看不清，至少到五世纪中叶，高卢元老精英的地方忠诚及利益明显压过了对罗马帝国政府的忠诚。他们的土地与财产在军事上日益得不到有效保护，也就很快不愿再忍受国库的征索。
高卢禁卫大区长官阿尔万杜斯在470年代被控给西哥特国王写信，建议由哥特人、罗马人和勃艮第人瓜分高卢。这一事例未必典型，却能说明问题，且怀有这种想法的并非只有他一人。
国家在西部筹措军费、维持军队遇到困难，罗马帝国权威的思想支配地位受到挑战，国家又无力维护行省精英的既得利益。到五世纪第三个四分之一（约450—475年），许多人觉得，若要保住社会地位、财富和影响力，最好同西部行省的新兴势力妥协，尤其是西哥特人和法兰克人。

But provincial elites were loyal to a distant government— indeed to any government— only so long as their own interests were protected by the state, and insofar as the state was able effectively to impose sanctions in some form on those who challenged its authority or failed to support it. Disaffection from or hostility to the imperial center was about a slippage in the correspondence between the perceived vested interests of a local elite and those of the state. And elites have been historically remarkably consistent in preserving their interests, whatever the compromises they may have had to make in order to do so. The North African elite, for example, did little to defend the interests of the church and its clergy against the Vandals in the 430s and thereafter, preferring to preserve their own interests. The somewhat precarious ideological loyalty such a response indicates underlines the self-interested nature of elite society, examples of which can be multiplied and from widely different periods and societies.

While this was certainly an indication, by the middle decades of the fifth century, for example, if not already some decades before then, it is clear that local loyalties among the Gallic senatorial elite and their interests were more powerful than loyalty to the imperial government in Rome, and that willingness to tolerate the demands of the fisc in the context of a decreasingly effective military defense of their lands and property was rapidly dissipating.

The case of the praetorian prefect of the Gauls, Arvandus, accused in the 470s of writing to the king of the Visigoths to suggest the partition of Gaul among Goths, Romans and Burgundians, may not be typical, but it is certainly an indication, and he was not alone in his sentiments.

The difficulties faced by the state in financing and maintaining its armies in the west, the challenges to the ideological hegemony of Roman imperial authority, and the inability of the state to defend elite vested interests in the provinces meant that, by the third quarter of the century, compromising with the new powers in the western provinces— the Visigoths and the Franks in particular— seemed preferable to many, in order to maintain social status, wealth, and influence.
For the eastern empire in the seventh century, the demands of the situation were not so very different in several respects.

东罗马国家有几种手段巩固对地方精英的控制，强制与惩处便是一途。七世纪的安纳托利亚不同于帝国较远的地区，挑战权威的人在君士坦丁堡政府能够有效打击的范围内，即使施以惩处并不总是一件简单的事。君士坦丁堡同亚美尼亚以及各地方统治者的往来，也许最能说明这一点。地方统治者对帝国的政策往往摇摆不定，尤其因为一直有来自哈里发国的报复或进攻的威胁。授予帝国的头衔和职务，往往能有效争取亚美尼亚精英来支持帝国，不过在当时的情况下，这常常只能奏效一时。即使离首都这么远，害怕遭帝国军事报复或失去罗马宫廷的青睐，一般也能保证他们忠于罗马。

帝国在该地区的政策诚然算不上特别成功，但如果在640年代起大部分时候那样艰难的形势下，帝国的手仍能伸到亚美尼亚高地，无论在军事上还是在教会政治上都是如此，那么在离本土更近的地方，这种权力的作用又该大多少？即便哈里发国大力介入，罗马对安纳托利亚中部和东部的政治控制也很少受到质疑。例如，667/668年亚美尼亚军统帅萨博里乌斯企图叛乱，君士坦斯二世政府很快就能派出大部队前去征讨，同时主动开展外交，劝阻穆阿维叶支持叛军。

尽管阿拉伯人的袭掠持续不断，偶尔还有大规模进攻，罗马军队仍遍布各地，或分散在各行省的驻地，或为特定战役集中较多兵力。因此，可以合理地假定，任何行省精英若要背弃帝国，都不得不顾忌相当迅速的报复与惩罚。无意作循环论证，结果本身已说明这一点。如第三章所见，托罗斯山与反托罗斯山防线之后，国家几乎没有放弃任何领土，也几乎没有放弃任何重要的堡垒或要塞。如果帝国能如此有效地守住领土，也就没有多少理由怀疑它能将权力施及行省精英，确保他们的忠诚。

The eastern Roman state had several means of consolidating its hold over a local elite. Coercion and sanctions represented one approach. In seventh-century Anatolia, in contrast to more distant regions of the empire, the government at Constantinople was in effective striking distance of those who challenged its authority, even if applying sanctions was not always a straightforward matter. This is perhaps most apparent in Constantinopolitan dealings with Armenia and the various local rulers whose policy with regard to the empire was often ambivalent, especially with the constant threat of reprisals or attacks from the caliphate. Imperial titles and offices were often efficacious in winning members of the Armenian elite over to the imperial cause, although in the conditions of the time this was often for the short term only. Yet even this far from the capital it was generally the case that the fear of imperial military reprisals or loss of prestige with the Roman court could secure loyalty to the Roman cause.

Admittedly, imperial policy in this region was not especially successful, but the point is that if the imperial arm could reach as far as the Armenian highlands, both militarily as well as in respect of ecclesiastical politics, even under such very straitened circumstances as prevailed across much of the period from the 640s onward, then how much more effective was it nearer to home? Even with substantial interference from the caliphate, Roman political control over central and eastern Anatolia was rarely in doubt. As the example of the attempted rebellion by the general Saborius, commander of the Armeniakon division, in 667/668 indicates, the government of Constans II was very quickly able to dispatch a substantial punitive force to deal with this while also pursuing a diplomatic offensive to dissuade Muʿawiya from lending his support to the rebels.

In spite of the continuous Arab raiding and occasional major offensive operations, Roman forces were ubiquitous, whether dispersed in their local provincial bases or in more concentrated numbers for particular campaigns. In consequence, it is a reasonable assumption that no member of the provincial elite could afford to abandon the imperial cause without fear of relatively swift reprisals and punishment. Without wishing to introduce a circular argument, the results speak for themselves: again as we have seen in Chapter 3, once behind the Taurus/Anti-Taurus line, virtually no territory and hardly any significant forts or fortresses were abandoned by the state. If the empire was able so effectively to hold onto its territory in this respect, there is little reason to doubt it was able to reach out to the provincial elites to ensure their loyalty.

不过，单凭强制并不够，至少从长远看如此。如果政府不能在某种程度上回报行省的效忠，行省对中央的忠诚便会摇摆。将叙利亚、北非以及意大利与西西里作对照，便能看清这些问题。我们已经看到，在叙利亚，帝国没能保卫自己的领土，也未能解救遭阿拉伯军队包围或威胁的城市，精英因而或出逃，或归附。逃走的似乎主要是以城市为中心、讲希腊语的精英的较高阶层。许多人也留了下来，把自己的前途同征服者联系在一起，视之为保住其财产与地位的最好办法。大马士革的约翰的家族也许就是很好的例子。
在这里，君士坦丁堡政府和当地居民所面对的问题都相对清楚。帝国基本无力施救，人们只能逃离或妥协。

But coercion alone was not enough, at least not over the longer term, and without some degree of reciprocity on the part of the government, provincial loyalty to the center was ambivalent. By way of contrast and comparison, the examples of Syria, North Africa, and Italy with Sicily offer good illustrations of these points. In Syria, as we have now seen, the failure of the empire to protect its territories and to relieve the cities besieged or threatened by the Arabs led either to the flight or to the surrender of members of the elite, and it seems largely to have been the upper levels of the urban-centered Greek-speaking elites who left— many stayed and threw in their lot with the conquerors as the best way to preserve their property and position. The family of John of Damascus may be a good example.

Here the problem for the both the government at Constantinople and for the indigenous populations was relatively clear— the empire was basically unable to help, and the only recourse was flight or compromise.
使形势复杂的因素，还有军事或后勤以外的事情。教义问题与政治认同，以及对神与人、天上王国与地上王国之间关系的信念，密不可分。如前所见，信仰之争直接影响了这一时期的政治。
马克西姆所代表的神学立场，显然影响了教会成员与世俗精英如何认识自己的世界，又如何在其中行动。

争论既涉及维护二性论派，也就是卡尔西顿派教会内部的团结，也涉及如何界定活动或能量以及意志。不过，双方立场针锋相对。政府把对自身立场的挑战，视为对世俗帝国的统一，对皇帝、帝国和帝国教会权威的挑战，因此也视为对它们能否在外来威胁和挑战（这里是哈里发国的挑战）中存续的挑战。不过，当统治者及其顾问和“官方”教会偏离别人认为正确的解释时，政体的生存就会受到威胁，基督教本身的统一也会破裂，因为他们不能同创制新教义的人共融。

The situation was complicated by other factors than the purely military or logistical. Issues of doctrine and dogma were intimately bound up with issues of political identity and beliefs about the relationship between the divinity and humankind, about the relationship between the heavenly and earthly kingdoms; as we have seen already, the politics of belief had a direct impact on the politics of the period.
The theological position represented by Maximus clearly had implications for the way in which members of the church and the secular elite understood and acted within their world.

The issue was about both the preservation of unity within the dyophysite— the Chalcedonian— church as well as about the definition of operations/energies and wills. But there were two diametrically opposed standpoints. The government saw challenges to its own position as challenges to the unity of the secular empire, to the authority of the emperor, the empire and the imperial church, and thus to their survival in the face of external threats and challenges—in this case, the challenge from the caliphate. But where a ruler, his advisors, and the “official” church deviated from what others saw as correct understanding, then not only was the life of the polity threatened, but the unity of Christianity as such was broken since there could be no communion with innovators.

两种立场，无论在650年代马克西姆受审时，还是在641/642年马克西姆和前君士坦丁堡牧首皮鲁斯较早的一次论辩中，都表现得十分清楚。后一次论辩马上就会谈到。如第二章所见，近期研究强调，特别是在约翰·莫斯库斯、耶路撒冷的索弗罗尼乌斯和忏悔者马克西姆的神学发展中，圣餐礼已成为起决定作用的圣礼，是划分信仰和实践对错的关键标志。马克西姆受审和被讯问时，确实把对一志论的抵制建立在断然拒绝与君士坦丁堡共融的立场上。
这些观念在参与论争以及审理马丁和马克西姆案件的神学家与政治家之外，传播到了多广的范围，不得而知。不过，帝国政府必须认真对待这种公开挑战，否则既会失面子，也会丧失公信力。如前所述，圣餐礼居于中心地位，确实也是西奈的阿纳斯塔修斯的著作及《问答录》所给忠告的一个重要方面。

The two positions are made very clear, both in the trial of Maximus in the 650s and in the earlier disputation between Maximus and the former patriarch of Constantinople Pyrrhus in 641/642, to be discussed shortly. As we saw in Chapter 2, recent scholarship has emphasized the fact that in the development of the theology of John Moschus, Sophronius of Jerusalem and Maximus the Confessor in particular, the Eucharist had become the defining sacrament, the one key symbol through which the difference between correct and incorrect belief and practice was demarcated, and it is certainly the case that during his trial and interrogations Maximus based his resistance to monotheletism on an absolute refusal to enter communion with Constantinople.

How far these ideas penetrated below the level of the theologians and statesmen who were involved in the debates and in the trials of Martin and Maximus is not known. But the imperial government had to take the public challenge seriously or lose both face and credibility, and as we have noted, the centrality of the Eucharist was certainly an important element in the work of Anastasius of Sinai, for example, and in the advice contained in his questions and answers.

body.review: 马克西姆与皮鲁斯的论辩在原书此处（第198页）记作641/642年，紧接着的第199页则作645年。两处各依原印。

children: 马克西姆所建立的个人交往关系，对于他的神学影响当时的政治发展至关重要。联系他的神学立场，有人提出，他在640年代初向西迁移，是因为当时阿非利加行省政府的领导层已同君士坦丁堡的帝国政府产生分歧。就在这个时候，阿非利加的禁卫大区长官乔治同皇后玛尔提娜发生争执，围绕的是一道释放几位来自埃及、被指信奉异端的修女的命令。玛尔提娜在641年失势，看来暂时化解了这一事端，但形势并未好转。
马克西姆成为反对帝国一志论者的中心人物。他据以立论的立场，构成了他日渐强烈的敌意的根基，也阐明了这种敌意的性质。这在645年同前君士坦丁堡牧首皮鲁斯的公开论辩中体现得很清楚，出席论辩的还有北非的军事长官、
贵族
兼总督格里高利。论辩中，马克西姆坚守教义的
akribeia
原则，即精确严谨。对手则持相反立场，主张务实，支持
oikonomia
，即通融。

The personal associations that Maximus had developed were crucial to the impact his theology had on contemporary political developments, and in the context of his own theological position it has been suggested that his move westward in the early 640s was associated with the fact that leading elements of the African provincial government were already at odds with the imperial government at Constantinople. It was in fact at just this time that a disagreement arose between the (praetorian) prefect of Africa, George, and the empress Martina, over an order to release some nuns from Egypt accused of heretical beliefs. Martina’s fall from power in 641 seems to have temporarily resolved the situation, but it did not improve.

Maximus became the focus of opposition to imperial monotheletism. The position from which he argued, and which forms the basis and clarifies the nature of his evolving hostility, is made quite clear in a public disputation with the former Constantinopolitan patriarch Pyrrhus, held in the presence of the military governor of North Africa, the
patrikios
and exarch Gregory, in 645. In the course of this debate, Maximus defended the principle of
akribeia
, exactitude, in matters of dogma, contrary to the position adopted by his opponent, who made the case for a pragmatic approach, for
oikonomia
, or accommodation.
630年代和640年代初，帝国因丧失东部行省和埃及而遭受灾难，声望已经受损。
军事胜利是罗马统治者及政治体制取得正当性的关键。不能获胜所造成的问题，出现于这个世纪之前，
但帝国从640和650年代起面临的特殊挑战，使这些问题格外尖锐。如第二章所见，当时抵御外敌的成败与政治及宗教的正当性联系得极为紧密。总督格里高利本人的立场因此也变得清楚了一点。首先，他不顾
《信仰阐述》

所宣布的禁令，准许论辩举行（其中一位辩论者是前牧首，也改变不了这点）。646年，他允许两场地方教会会议召开，地点分别是阿非利加总督辖区和比扎凯纳。此后，这两个行省及其他行省的好几位主教，包括迦太基主教，似乎都公开宣布支持传统的卡尔西顿派立场。马克西姆的影响，加上格里高利没有压下对帝国立场的反对，显然导致了剧烈的变化，从帝国角度看极不乐见。马克西姆到来以前，并无反对一志论的证据，虽然阿非利加禁卫大区长官乔治同君士坦丁堡的争执表明，两地关系有些紧张。然而不出一年，北非已成为反对帝国的宣传和教会反抗的中心。
最后大约在646年，格里高利被拥立为皇帝，直接挑战了在君士坦丁堡替尚且年幼的君士坦斯二世治理国家的政府。
他的动机仍有争论。他可能确实想取代君士坦斯二世及其顾问的统治，反映了645年帝国进攻埃及失败所带来的失望或幻灭，也可能正是受此激发，
或许还会像希拉克略那样，设法直接进攻君士坦丁堡。他也可能是想建立一个独立自主、层级低于帝国的国家，以便更好地抵御阿拉伯人的入侵。
Imperial prestige had already suffered as a result of the disasters that beset the empire in the 630s and early 640s with the loss of the eastern provinces and Egypt.
Military victory was a key element in the legitimation of Roman rulers and political regimes, and while the problems that arose in its absence were not new to this century,

the very particular challenges faced by the empire from the 640s and 650s onward rendered them especially acute at a time when success against an external threat and political and religious legitimacy were, as we have seen in Chapter 2, so closely bound together. The exarch Gregory’s own position in consequence becomes a little clearer at this point. First, he permitted a debate, contrary to the prohibition enunciated in the
Ekthesis

(the fact that a former patriarch was his co-disputant, cannot have altered this). In 646 he permitted the holding of two local provincial councils (in Africa Proconsularis and Byzacena), following which a number of bishops from these and other provinces, including the bishop of Carthage, appear to have made their support of the traditional Chalcedonian position public. Maximus’s influence and Gregory’s failure to stifle opposition to the imperial cause clearly had dramatic and very unwelcome results from the point of view of the empire. There is no evidence for antimonothelete sentiment before Maximus’s arrival, although the dispute between the praetorian prefect of Africa, George, and Constantinople suggests a degree of tension between the region and Constantinople; within a year North Africa had become the focus of anti-imperial propaganda and ecclesiastical opposition.
And finally, probably in 646, Gregory was proclaimed emperor in a direct challenge to the government at Constantinople that acted for the still young Constans II.

His motives remain debated. He may have intended seriously to replace the rule of Constans II and his advisors, reflecting or stimulated by disappointment or disillusion at the failed imperial attack against Egypt in 645,

and would perhaps have made an attempt on Constantinople itself, as Heraclius had done. He may have intended to establish an autonomous subimperial state in order the better to resist Arab incursions.
究竟如何，无从断定。最后，他于647年在苏费图拉（斯贝特拉）迎击阿拉伯袭掠部队时战死。

但毫无疑问，这确实构成了对现有政权的挑战，而且很可能得到了马克西姆在道义上的支持。马克西姆后来在君士坦丁堡受审时，并没有否认关于他曾做过一个梦的说法。在那个梦里，有一队天使击败了另一队，象征篡位者格里高利最终将获胜。乍一看这或许无足轻重，却不可低估这样的梦所具有的相当大的权威和意义。如已有研究所指出，人们的确非常认真地对待这类梦，既认为它们显示上帝的支持或反对，也认为它们预示民众与精英可能作出的肯定或否定的反应。自六世纪后期至八世纪初，莫里斯、查士丁尼二世、莱昂提奥斯和菲利皮科斯·巴尔达内斯，都曾直接或间接地与号称预示其统治成败的梦或预言有关。因此，君士坦斯二世的政府对于马克西姆曾做这个梦的报告有些忧虑，也就不足为奇了。
It is impossible to say. And in the end, he died in battle while confronting an Arab raid at Sufetula (Sbeitla) in 647.

But there is little doubt that this was a genuine challenge to the existing regime and that it was very likely morally supported by Maximus, who, during his later trial in Constantinople, did not deny reports that he had had a dream in which the eventual victory of the usurper Gregory was symbolically represented by the victory of one angelic choir over another. While this may at first sight seem trivial, we should not underestimate the considerable authority or significance ascribed to such dreams, as has been pointed out: they were taken very seriously indeed, as indications both of divine support or opposition as well as pointers to potential popular and elite opinion, whether positive or negative. From the later sixth to early eighth centuries Maurice, Justinian II, Leontius, and Philippicus Bardanes were all associated directly or indirectly with dreams or prophecies purporting to indicate the success or failure of their rule, and so it is not surprising to find that the government of Constans II regarded the report of Maximus’s dream with some concern.
同对波斯的战争期间一样，北非与西西里不得不担负起向君士坦丁堡供应物资的重担。618年埃及失陷后，都城的城市
annona
（粮食配给）取消。自那以后不久，阿非利加对于国库以及君士坦丁堡粮食供应的重要性，已经十分明显。
从这一时期起，与迦太基和北非相关的一些
kommerkiarioi
印玺，见证了这些官员的活动。一种有说服力的论证认为，自波斯占领埃及后的若干年起，直至总督格里高利于647年篡位并战败，这些官员一直参与了为君士坦丁堡供应谷物的措施。
国库长官
菲拉格里乌斯于641年被短暂放逐到北非（塞普特姆行省，以摩洛哥今休达为中心，与直布罗陀隔海相望），随后在640年代初开始推行一次新的全帝国税额核定。尤其考虑到埃及已经丧失，北非很可能是他估算中的一个主要财源。
此外，例如约640—680年及稍后的短时间里，北非商品仍出口到意大利南部与君士坦丁堡，这大概既反映了私人商业交易，也反映了由国家组织的物资运送。
阿非利加地主本来就面临阿拉伯人袭扰造成的经济与政治失序，从君士坦丁堡又得不到多少军事援助，处境艰难。645年的远征，可能曾被视为改善形势的真正机会。

Just as during the Persian wars, North Africa (along with Sicily) had had to shoulder the burden of supplying Constantinople with resources. The importance of Africa to the fisc as well as to the grain supply of Constantinople had already become very clear in the period immediately after the loss of Egypt in 618, when the civic
annona
for the capital was cancelled.
From this time a number of seals of
kommerkiarioi

associated with Carthage and North Africa testify to the activities of officials who, it has been plausibly argued, were associated with the measures taken to supply Constantinople with grain during the years after the Persian occupation of Egypt and lasting up to the usurpation and defeat of the exarch Gregory in 647.
In the early 640s the
sakellarios,

Philagrius, who had been exiled briefly in 641 to North Africa (the province of Septem, focused around mod. Ceuta in Morocco, opposite Gibraltar) had begun implementing a new empire-wide tax assessment, and it is likely that North Africa figured in his calculations as a major source of revenue, especially in light of the loss of Egypt.

And North African wares were still being exported to southern Italy and to Constantinople in the period ca. 640–680 and a little beyond, for example, probably reflecting both private commercial transactions as well as state-sponsored movement of goods.

African landowners, already facing economic and political disruption from Arab raids and with little military assistance from Constantinople, were left in a difficult situation. The expedition of 645 may have been seen as a real opportunity for an improvement in the situation.

然而，希望落空了。这很可能正是格里高利的行动得到支持的原因，马克西姆与北非教会的许多主教在观念上的支持，又进一步加强了这种支持。如前一章所见，帝国民政与军事机构的高层人士大多不是阿非利加人出身，虽有少数例外，进入七世纪后情况仍是如此。相较之下，虽然原本也有许多下属官员来自东方，或者至少不出身于阿非利加，但他们逐渐同本地罗马化的阿非利加民众融合。到七世纪中叶，下属官员已多为本地人，而世俗精英和教会精英大体仍为罗马阿非利加人。因此，东部任命的官员与本地的罗马阿非利加精英之间，有着明显界限。不过，
贵族
兼总督格里高利可能同希拉克略皇帝家族有亲缘关系，同时又与阿非利加有密切联系。
普罗科皮乌斯提到了罗马阿非利加人与“罗马人”，即东罗马人或拜占庭人之间的区别。如已有研究指出，后来一位阿拉伯编年史家也同样区分了罗马阿非利加人、罗马人和摩尔人。
群体分界如此鲜明，对入侵之际的团结抵抗，或高压情势下对遥远皇帝的忠诚，都没有多少助益。究竟是马克西姆坚持的严守教义的论点，先激起不满，继而促成对君士坦丁堡的公开反抗，还是北非教士与精英已经因严苛的征税对政府有所离心，让他的论点有了适合扎根的土壤，仍不得而知。毋庸置疑，同其他重要神学家的观点一样，他的观点能产生相当大的影响，尤其是在收到他来信、具有读写能力的社会和文化精英中。
不过，格里高利看来显然既得到行省精英的支持，也得到北非教会高层的支持。
此后，正是阿非利加的精英出面同阿拉伯人谈判，商定付给他们多少财物以换取撤兵。跟拉文纳总督区一样，到这时，北非的精英很可能相当一部分已由本行省出身的人组成，也就是担任帝国军队指挥职务及其他官职的罗马阿非利加人。时间稍晚一些的报道说，647年苏费图拉附近的战斗中，本行省的许多“显贵”与格里高利本人一道战死，这也许进一步支持了这一推测。

But the hope was dashed, and it may well have been this that lent support to Gregory’s actions, further bolstered by the ideological support given by Maximus and many bishops of the North African church. As we have seen in the preceding chapter, the leading members of the imperial civil and military administration were largely, although not entirely, non-African in origin, and this remained the case into the seventh century. In contrast, although many subordinate officers were easterners or at least not of African background, the process of assimilation with the indigenous Romano-African population meant that by the middle of the seventh century the majority were locals while the secular elite and ecclesiastical elites remained largely Romano-African. There was thus a clear division between eastern appointees and the indigenous Romano-African elite, but the
patrikios
and exarch Gregory, possibly related to the family of the emperor Heraclius, had strong African connections.

The distinction between Romano-Africans and “Romans”— that is to say, eastern Romans/Byzantines— was noted by Procopius; and as has also been pointed out, a later Arab chronicler similarly distinguishes between Romano-Africans, Romans, and Moors.

Such clear demarcation between groups can have contributed little to the solidarity of any resistance to an invader or, under stressful conditions, to loyalty to a distant emperor. It remains unknown whether the rigorist theological arguments defended by Maximus first promoted unquiet and then outright opposition to Constantinople, or whether his arguments fell on fertile ground because of a North African clergy and elite already partially disaffected from the government because of harsh fiscal demands. There is no doubt that his views, like those of other important theologians, could exert a good deal of influence, especially among the literate social-cultural elite who were in receipt of his letters.
But it appears clear that Gregory enjoyed the support of the provincial elite as well as the North African church hierarchy.

It was members of the African elite who negotiated with the Arabs thereafter over the subsidies intended to buy the Arabs off. As in the Ravenna exarchate, it is likely that a significant element of the North African elite was by this time made up of members of provincial origin, Romano-Africans who held imperial military commands and offices, a possibility perhaps reinforced by somewhat later reports that at the battle near Sufetula in 647, many of the “notables” of the province were killed along with Gregory himself.
袭掠深入罗马阿非利加各行省，持续了一年多，又不见帝国援兵，阿非利加精英确实愿意交付巨额财物换取入侵者撤兵。巴拉祖里和瓦基迪提到的数额惊人，大概不能视为确数，但显然表明所付贡金极巨，其中可能一部分来自先前扣下未交的税收。
据瓦基迪说，阿拉伯人撤走后，帝国要求阿非利加各行省向国库交纳大致相同的款项。地方显贵声称无法交付，因为给阿拉伯人的贡金已经耗尽了他们的财力。这一要求很可能使精英进一步离心。较晚的一则阿拉伯记述略有渲染，说一位名流曾前往大马士革，劝说穆阿维叶征服整个北非，好让当地显贵免受这般财政折磨。
君士坦丁堡和北非教会间持续的紧张，可以从649年于罗马召开的拉特兰会议记录中清楚看出。稍晚一些，
《教皇列传》
又提到，663年以后，意大利和北非诸行省被课以沉重税赋。这一年，君士坦斯二世把司令部设在西西里，显然是想更好地保卫这些对财政至关重要的西部行省。这种征敛无疑是中央政府对西部行省，尤其是阿非利加和西西里，一贯的态度。
650年代，的黎波里塔尼亚部分地方仍有帝国的统帅管辖，证明帝国统治继续存在。不过，要抵挡阿拉伯人坚决的进攻及袭扰，现有资源显然不足。尽管据报665/666年曾派出大批军队，665—668年间，罗马仍失去了对比扎凯纳大部分地区的控制。

Following more than a year of pillaging and raiding deep into the provinces of Roman Africa, and with no imperial assistance in sight, the African elite were certainly willing to pay very substantial sums to buy off the invaders: the fantastic sums mentioned by Baladhuri and al-Waqidi are probably not to be taken at face value, but they clearly indicate a massive tribute, possibly partly made up from the revenues that had been held back.

The Arab withdrawal was followed— according to al-Waqidi—by an imperial demand that the African provinces pay a similar sum to the treasury, at which the notables of the region claimed they could not, since their tribute to the Arabs had exhausted their resources. That such a demand alienated the elite even further seems highly likely (a later somewhat embellished Arab account reports that one notable went to Damascus to persuade Muʿāwiya to pursue the conquest of North Africa in order to relieve the nobility of such fiscal afflictions).

The continuing tensions between Constantinople and the North African church can be clearly seen in the Acts of the Lateran council convened in Rome in 649. Somewhat later the oppressive tax demands imposed upon both the Italian and North African provinces after 663 (the year that Constans II established his headquarters in Sicily, surely with the aim of being the better able to defend these fiscally important western provinces) are mentioned in the
Liber pontificalis
and were no doubt typical of the central government’s attitude to the western provinces, especially Africa and Sicily.

The presence of an imperial commander in charge of parts of Tripolitania in the 650s indicates continuing imperial government, but the resources to resist a determined Arab campaign and raiding were clearly inadequate, and Roman control over much of Byzacena was lost in the years 665–668 in spite of the reported dispatch of substantial forces in the year 665/666.
无论如何，地方异议、拒斥帝国权威及行省寻求自主的倾向，都严重挑战了政府维持权威并提取财政资源的能力。然而，这些挑战似乎并非针对体制本身。如近期一项研究所作的有说服力的论证，这些挑战是对具体帝国政策的回应，例如帝国推行的一志论，或被认为特别严苛或不公的征税，并非针对罗马帝国及其统治者本身。
君士坦丁堡知道地方精英至关重要，却也把他们在巨大压力下的忠诚视为理所当然。政府哪怕无力提供军事援助或解围，也强烈反对地方上为保卫行省利益而同入侵者议和的努力。630年代后期美索不达米亚、埃及，或格里高利败后的北非，似乎都曾采取这样的举措。帝国把它们视为对中央权威的威胁，不予认可。
有这一背景，再看655年对马克西姆审判时所提出的证据，便不难理解他为何被控叛国大罪，例如据称他曾鼓动努米底亚的帝国将领彼得违抗直接命令，不去进攻敌军。事实上，现有证据强烈表明，马克西姆曾有意削弱帝国权威，从而动摇帝国的稳定。

In any case, local dissent, rejection of imperial authority, and tendencies toward provincial autonomy were all a serious challenge to the government’s ability to maintain its authority and to extract fiscal resources. But such challenges appear not to have been systemic; that is to say, they were responses to specific imperial policies— imperial monotheletism, for example, or fiscal demands seen as especially harsh or unfair— rather than to the Roman Empire and its rulers as such, as a recent study has persuasively demonstrated.

Constantinople recognized the crucial importance of local elites but also took their loyalty under extreme pressure for granted. Even where the government was unable to provide military assistance or relief it strongly resented local efforts at defending provincial interests and making peace with the invader. Such initiatives, as seem to have occurred in Mesopotamia in the late 630s, in Egypt or in North Africa after Gregory’s defeat, were perceived as threats to central authority and frowned upon.

But in the light of all this, and of the evidence presented at the trial of Maximus in 655, it is hardly surprising that high treason— his reported encouraging of the imperial commander in Numidia, Peter, to disobey a direct order to attack the enemy, for example— was the charge, and indeed the available evidence does strongly suggest that Maximus had deliberately aimed at undermining imperial authority and thus destabilizing the empire.
650年代之后，书面史料几乎完全缺失，所以北非的情形难以追踪。不过看来，除了迦太基与其周边腹地，尤其是最容易通往港口的谷物产区，较大范围的北非在接下来半个世纪里缓慢脱离了帝国的控制。尽管政府有时试图扭转这一趋势，罗马阿非利加居民也仍认同帝国，却未能改变这一结果。
帝国军队一直驻扎在迦太基及周边地区，直到最后。他们显然既继续行动，也对政府保持忠诚。君士坦斯二世在669年被刺杀后，北非的军队也参与镇压米齐齐乌斯在西西里的叛乱。迦太基的造币厂仍在运转。
在这个漫长过程中，也须考虑战略形势，在地理上需要保卫什么样的领土，主要的城市和要塞有多大现实或潜在的防守能力。
不过，对任何抵抗而言，地方精英的作用必然是关键。无论苏费图拉的战败是否真给北非精英以近乎灭顶的打击，
他们在这个过程中的作用（或他们的缺席）必定相当重要，而政府相对沉重的征敛也无助于改善他们的处境。直到690年代，沿海城镇仍处于帝国权威之下。但最终，尽管仍有一些帝国军队留驻，东方有时也派来人数大得多的远征军，而且政府显然希望保住北非，它实在无力投入长期有效防卫所需的资源，更重要的是，无力压下地方上与入侵者妥协的倾向。

Although the North African situation is difficult to follow because of the near total absence of written sources after the 650s, it does seem that, apart from Carthage and its immediate hinterland, in particular the grain-producing districts with easiest access to the port, the wider region slowly slipped out of imperial control across the following half century, in spite of occasional government efforts to reverse the process and the continuing identity of the Romano-African populace with the empire.

Imperial forces were based in and around Carthage until the end and were clearly both active and remained loyal to the government: North African units were involved in suppressing the rebellion of Mizizius on Sicily in the wake of the assassination of Constans II in 669. The mint at Carthage continued to operate.

And while the strategic situation needs also to be taken into account in this long, drawn-out process— the geography of the territory to be defended along with the defensive capacity or potential of the major towns and fortresses
— the role of local elites would have been crucial to any resistance. Whether the North African elite was really as drastically affected by the defeat at Sufetula as to be almost annihilated or not,

their role in (or absence from) this process must have been significant, and the relatively oppressive fiscal demands of the government can have done little to help their situation. Coastal towns and cities remained under imperial authority until the 690s. In the end, however, and in spite of the continued presence of some imperial troops, the occasional much larger expeditionary forces dispatched from the east, and a clear desire to hold onto North Africa, the government was simply unable to devote the resources necessary for an effective long-term defense and, more importantly, to inhibit local tendencies to compromise with the invader.

children: 意大利的问题
Italian Questions
与北非一样，教廷和君士坦丁堡围绕帝国宗教政策的冲突，使意大利的情势变得复杂。七世纪后期和八世纪上半叶，君士坦丁堡的财政要求又进一步加深了这种复杂性。早在640年代，地方情绪与地方认同就可能压过对君士坦丁堡皇帝的忠诚。中央只能靠妥协、外交以及偶尔动用武力与强制来勉强维持控制，而且并不总能成功。645/646年，忏悔者马克西姆来到罗马，要为自己的立场争取教廷支持，这只让政府的处境更加艰难。
一些别的联系和关系在这里帮了他的忙，因为教皇狄奥多尔（642—649年在位），本人就是一位巴勒斯坦主教的儿子。狄奥多尔获选时没有得到帝国的批准，与其前任约翰四世（640—642年在位）一样，正式拒绝了
《信仰阐述》
马克西姆及其修道士支持者似乎发挥了不小的实际影响，使罗马和君士坦丁堡之间原已出现的裂痕迅速加深。前牧首皮鲁斯此时也已到罗马，放弃了对帝国立场的支持。狄奥多尔或许为此所鼓舞，公开与君士坦丁堡决裂，先致信君士坦斯二世（或其顾问），谴责一志论，随后废黜了君士坦丁堡的在任牧首保罗。
教皇召集了一场全体会议，即所谓的拉特兰会议。由于他去世，会议实际上在继任者马丁（649—653年在位）任内召开。会议再次谴责一志论。马克西姆与其追随者为会议记录预先拟稿的说法虽大概不足采信，但他无疑对会议的进程与结果有决定性的影响。

The situation in Italy was complicated, as in North Africa, by the conflict between the papacy and Constantinople over imperial religious policy and in the later seventh and first half of the eighth century by the fiscal demands of Constantinople. Already by the 640s local feeling and local identities could overcome loyalty to the emperor in Constantinople, and central control was a precarious matter of compromise, diplomacy, the occasional use of force and coercion, which was not always successful. The situation for the government was only worsened by the arrival in Rome of Maximus the Confessor in 645/646, who came in order to win papal support for his position.

Here further connections and associations served him well since the pope, Theodore (642–649), was himself the son of a Palestinian bishop. Theodore had been elected without imperial sanction and, like his predecessor, John IV (640–642), officially rejected the
Ekthesis.

The gulf that was already opening between Rome and Constantinople was dramatically widened as a result of the influence exercised by Maximus and his monastic supporters, which appears to have been both substantial and effective. In a public break with Constantinople, perhaps encouraged by the fact that the former patriarch, Pyrrhus, had meanwhile come to Rome and renounced his support for the imperial position, Theodore deposed the current patriarch of Constantinople, Paul, having first dispatched a letter to Constans II (or his councilors) denouncing monotheletism.

The pope summoned a general council— the so-called Lateran Synod— although he died and this meeting was held under his successor, Martin (649–653). Again, monotheletism was condemned, and although the suggestion that the acts of the council had been scripted by Maximus and his followers in advance is probably to be rejected, he certainly had a decisive influence over the council’s proceedings and its outcome.
我们对这些年间意大利发生的事，所知至多是个模糊的轮廓。部分原因是，关键史料
《教皇列传》
为了保全教皇的名声，省略了某些事件，对另一些事件看来则有意改动。
尽管如此，帝国的回应来得很慢。无疑，这一方面是因为643年士兵发生叛乱或哗变，首领是一名叫作莫里斯的
cartularius
（文书官），另一方面是因为伦巴第人再次侵占帝国领土，使总督的军队遭遇一连串败仗。耐人寻味的是，莫里斯声称，总督在策划一场自己的反帝国叛乱。实际情况如何已无从得知，莫里斯和总督以撒都在643年死去。
新总督柏拉图（约643—649年在任）没有立刻采取措施，直到649年，政府才得以有所行动。
这一次，总督奥林皮乌斯奉命去意大利压下教廷的反对，可到这时，当地的反对情绪似乎越来越强，君士坦丁堡在外交和军事上的投入又不够，君士坦斯二世的政府已很难应付局面。
《教皇列传》
声称，奥林皮乌斯应先试探意大利军队的态度，只有指望得上他们的支持，才可对教皇采取行动，将他逮捕。假如暂时得不到他们的支持，他就奉命等到将他们争取过来再行动。如果他们愿意支持，他就须强迫主教与教士签署君士坦斯二世在648年颁行的
《信仰规范》
，禁止进一步讨论神圣意志的问题。
Our knowledge of events in Italy during these years is hazy, to say the least, in part because the
Liber pontificalis,
a key source, omits or appears to have tendentiously modified some events in order to preserve papal reputations.
The imperial response to these developments was nevertheless slow, no doubt because of a rebellion or mutiny of soldiers led by a
cartularius,

a certain Maurice, in 643, and at the same time new encroachments on imperial territory by the Lombards, who inflicted a series of defeats on the forces of the exarch. Interestingly, Maurice claimed that the exarch was plotting his own rebellion against the empire, but it is impossible to know whether this was actually the case, and both Maurice and the exarch, Isaac, died in 643.
The new exarch, Plato (ca. 643–649), took no immediate action, and it was only in 649 that the government was able to make a move.

This time the exarch, Olympius, was ordered to Italy to snuff out the papal opposition, but by now it seems that increasingly strong local sentiment and inadequate investment diplomatically and militarily on the part of Constantinople had made the situation very difficult for the government of Constans II. The
Liber pontificalis

claims that Olympius was first to have sounded out the Italian forces and only act against the pope (by arresting him) if he could count on their support. If he could not, he was ordered to wait until such time as he had won them over. If they would support him, then he was to compel the bishops and clergy to sign up to the
Typos
issued by Constans II in 648, prohibiting further debate on the issue of divine wills.
结果看来，教皇马丁同时得到了意大利军队和自己教士的保护。虽然无从知道他与奥林皮乌斯怎样和解，后来的人却认为，马丁支持了奥林皮乌斯随后的篡位。马丁在君士坦丁堡受审时则声称，自己根本无力阻止这种事。
奥林皮乌斯自立为皇帝后，出兵应对阿拉伯人对西西里的进攻。由于西西里对教廷的收入十分重要，这很可能是由教皇促成的。
不久，篡位者死去，可能是由于罗马军队中暴发了疾病。新总督卡利奥帕斯得以在653年逮捕马丁与马克西姆，未遭抵抗，又将他们押往首都受审，两人都被控叛国。
反对君士坦丁堡的势力因此受到重大打击，但敌意与不满并未平息。马丁的继任者尤金尼乌斯（653—657年在位）在任时，事端再起。直到教皇答应拒绝君士坦丁堡新牧首彼得的就任通函，事端才告平息。

As it turned out, it would appear that Pope Martin was protected by both the army of Italy and his clergy, and although we cannot know how he and Olympius were reconciled, it was later believed that Martin supported Olympius’s subsequent usurpation— something he claimed during his trial in Constantinople that he simply could not have prevented.
Having declared himself emperor, Olympius set off to deal with an Arab attack on Sicily, very possibly at papal instigation, given the importance of the island to papal income.

When shortly thereafter the usurper died, probably in an outbreak of disease that had affected the Roman forces, the new exarch, Calliopas, was able in 653 to arrest both Martin and Maximus without opposition and have them taken for trial to the capital, where they were charged with treason.

Opposition to Constantinople suffered a serious blow as a result, but hostility and discontent smoldered on, with further disorders during the pontificate of Martin’s successor, Eugenius (653–657), ending only when the pope undertook to reject the synodical letters of Peter, the new patriarch of Constantinople.

此后教会关系一直疏远，直到680年君士坦丁堡会议上双方和解。不过，663至668年间，皇帝率相当规模的部队驻在意大利和西西里，双方有了某种非正式的共处办法。帝国在政治、军事上取得若干成果，尤以650年代中叶阿拉伯人的舰队进攻君士坦丁堡失败为著。随之而来的一段相对平静的时期，看来缓和了分歧。皇帝如今能同哈里发国订约，取得数年和平，因此得以恢复罗马对亚美尼亚诸公国的一定控制，随后经巴尔干进军，在那里短暂恢复一定程度的罗马权威，再进军意大利，直至罗马。
虽然不能完全证实，这场战役以及皇帝随后长期驻留西西里，目的都是重新确立帝国对仍在手中的西部地区的控制。他进攻贝内文托伦巴第人的战事，诚然未能完胜。不过，其军队确实夺回了几座城镇和要塞，开始加固众多用于避难的山地据点，并建立了此前缺乏的防御设施。他还组建了一支舰队，以保护该地区的沿岸水域。当然，这对阻止阿拉伯人攻击北非没有多少作用。尽管663至668年间曾派出由
贵族
尼基弗鲁斯统率的大军，但这支军队后来战败，攻击也继续下去。另一方面，由于教皇维塔利安（657—672年在位）采取和解立场，罗马与君士坦丁堡恢复了一定程度的和谐。君士坦斯既成功保护、保有了西西里的财富，也在政治上与教廷达成和解，虽然帝国推行的一志论仍是争执的议题。
皇帝与教皇共同举行圣餐礼，因而至少在表面上弥合了马克西姆和马丁如此鲜明地指出的共融裂痕。对当时的人而言，这肯定格外重要，尤其考虑到据
《教皇列传》
所载，罗马城中曾热烈支持马克西姆的巴勒斯坦修道团体，似乎并没有作声。
君士坦斯随后从新都叙拉古颁布有关财政的法令，向卡拉布里亚、西西里、阿非利加和撒丁等西部行省征税。这些税令教会不满，却似乎很少或根本没有引起抵抗或反对。

The ecclesiastical estrangement that ensued lasted until reconciliation at the council of Constantinople in 680, although in the period 663–668, while the emperor was in Italy and Sicily with significant forces, an informal modus vivendi prevailed. The acuteness of the disagreement seems to have been dulled by a period of relative quiet following some imperial political and military successes, in particular after the failure of an Arab naval attack on Constantinople in the mid-650s. The emperor was now able to conclude a treaty securing a few years of peace with the caliphate, and he could in consequence reestablish a degree of Roman control over the Armenian principalities before campaigning through the Balkans, restoring a short-lived degree of Roman authority there, and then into Italy and to Rome.

Although it cannot be shown beyond doubt, this campaign, followed by his prolonged stay in Sicily, was aimed at reestablishing imperial control over the western regions still in imperial hands. It is true that his campaign against the Lombards of Benevento was not crowned with complete success, although his forces certainly recovered several towns and fortress, began the fortification of a large number of mountain refuges, and created a defensive infrastructure that had been lacking hitherto. He also constructed a fleet to safeguard the coastal waters of the region. This did little to halt Arab attacks in North Africa, of course, which continued in spite of the dispatch (and subsequent defeat) of a substantial force under the
patrikios

Nicephorus at some point between 663 and 668. On the other hand, thanks to a conciliatory position adopted by Pope Vitalian (657–672), some harmony was reestablished between Rome and Constantinople, while Constans also succeeded in protecting and securing the wealth of Sicily as well as politically reconciling with the papacy (even if imperial monotheletism was still a bone of contention).

The fact that emperor and pope celebrated the Eucharist together, thus at least on the face of things overcoming the breach in communion that had been so clearly highlighted by Maximus and Martin, must have been especially significant for contemporaries, especially in light of the apparent silence (according to the report in the
Liber pontificalis
) of the Palestinian monastic community in the city that had so fervently supported Maximus.

From his new capital at Syracuse, Constans then issued legislation on fiscal matters regarding the western provinces— Calabria, Sicily, Africa, and Sardinia— imposing taxes that, while resented by the church, appear to have aroused little or no resistance or opposition.
但668年，在阿拉伯人对君士坦丁堡发动一次大规模进攻期间，皇帝在叙拉古的住处遇刺。这显然是一场宫廷政变，没有证据表明地方军队或更广范围的西部部队支持这一阴谋。事件的确切经过仍不清楚，学者提出了各种有关背景的推测，有的说阴谋出自君士坦丁堡，有的说是哈里发穆阿维叶策划了刺杀，却都无法证实。
皇帝去世后，亚美尼亚将领、奥普西基翁部队的
komes
姆泽兹（米齐齐乌斯）·格努尼随即篡夺了帝位。各史料记载相互抵牾，这场篡位具体持续了多久，不得而知。但从君士坦丁堡派来的帝国军队，在669年都城解围前不可能抵达。事实上，直到672年，事情可能才告终结。
不久之后，阿拉伯舰队便发动了一次袭击，攻占并洗劫叙拉古，随后满载战利品返回埃及。不过，意大利和阿非利加的军队都作出反应，镇压了叛乱，清楚表明他们忠于既有秩序。教皇维塔利安也同样支持君士坦丁堡的合法政权，或许是明白帝国对于保护教廷在西西里的地产何等重要。680年会议记录里保存了皇帝君士坦丁四世写给教皇的一封信，他在信中感谢教皇支持他反对篡位者，便可见这一点。

But in 668 the emperor was assassinated in his residence in Syracuse in what was clearly a palace coup (and in the course of a major Arab assault on Constantinople), and there is no evidence to suggest that local forces, or western units more widely, were supportive of the plot. The exact course of events remains obscure, and scholars have proposed a variety of theories about the background, none provable, ranging from a plot engineered from Constantinople to an assassination planned by the caliph Muʿāwiya.
The immediate outcome of the emperor’s death was the usurpation of the throne by an Armenian general, the
komes

of the Opsikion, Mzez (Mizizius) Gnouni. Exactly how long this lasted remains unknown because of the contradictory sources, but the imperial forces sent from Constantinople cannot have arrived before the end of the siege of the capital in 669, and in fact it was probably not ended until 672.

It was followed very soon by an Arab naval raid that was able to take and sack Syracuse and return to Egypt loaded with booty. Yet Italian and African troops responded to suppress the rebellion, a clear indication of their loyalty to the established order; while Pope Vitalian, perhaps conscious of the empire’s importance in protecting papal estates on Sicily, similarly supported the legitimate regime in Constantinople, as indicated by a letter from the emperor Constantine IV to the pope, preserved in the acts of the council of 680, in which the emperor thanked him for his support against usurpers.
这种和解的一个可能后果，是君士坦丁四世决定扭转帝国关于单一意志教义的政策。680年会议召开之前，罗马教会的特权得到确认，教会获准免税，曾获君士坦斯二世批准自主的拉文纳教会也重归罗马管辖。君士坦丁堡在680—681年召开的会议上放弃帝国一志论，正式恢复了两个牧首座之间的共融。

查士丁尼二世延续了和解，尽管罗马拒绝接受691—692年在君士坦丁堡召开的所谓五六会议的多条教规，在君士坦丁堡引发了一些难处。最终，皇帝作出了妥协，在不明言的情况下承认了教皇的权威。约翰七世（705—710年在位）任教皇时，查士丁尼请他在罗马召开教会会议，正式接受罗马教会能够接受的五六会议教规，拒绝其余条文。帝国对教廷与罗马的态度有了明显改变，在查士丁尼在位时尤其如此。皇帝已无法再像君士坦斯二世一样直接干预。相反，教皇君士坦丁（708—715年在位）访问君士坦丁堡期间，皇帝表现出明显的谦逊与善意，查士丁尼想维系罗马支持的愿望也格外明显。

One likely consequence of this rapprochement was Constantine IV’s decision to reverse imperial policy with regard to the doctrine of the single will. In the period prior to the convening of the council of 680, Roman ecclesiastical privileges were confirmed, fiscal exemptions were granted, and the church of Ravenna— granted autocephaly by Constans II— was returned to Roman authority. The council of Constantinople, held in 680–681, saw the abandonment by Constantinople of imperial monotheletism, reestablishing formally once again communion between the two patriarchates.

The rapprochement was continued under Justinian II, although Roman rejection of a number of the canons of the so-called Quinisext Council, held in Constantinople in 691–692, caused some difficulties in Constantinople. This eventually resulted in an implicit recognition of papal authority with a compromise on the part of the emperor when, during the pontificate of John VII (705–710), Justinian invited the pope to convene a synod in Rome formally to accept those canons of the Quinisext that it could and to reject the others. The clear shift in imperial approaches to the papacy and to Rome is evident in Justinian’s reign in particular. No longer could an emperor intervene in the direct way that Constans II had been able to do. To the contrary, Justinian’s desire to maintain Roman support becomes especially obvious in the marked display of imperial humility and goodwill during the visit of Pope Constantine (708–715) to Constantinople.
这一切必然使君士坦丁堡与拉文纳日益紧张的关系雪上加霜，或许还进一步助长了支持地方自主、甚至疏离帝都的情绪。帝国虽确实重新赢得了教廷支持，仍须谨慎行事。菲利皮科斯·巴尔达内斯（711—713年在位）正式恢复推行一志论，消息传来，便有人武装反抗新皇帝任命罗马
dux
（军事统帅）的决定。教廷和罗马精英断然拒绝了这一政策，
《教皇列传》
甚至史无前例地斥责皇帝为异端。

All this certainly exacerbated the strained relations that had been developing between Constantinople and Ravenna and may have further promoted sentiments in favor of regional autonomy and even alienation from the capital of the empire. And while papal support was certainly regained, caution still had to be exercised. When Philippicus Bardanes (711–713) formally reestablished a monothelete policy, the news was met with armed resistance to the new emperor’s appointment of the
dux,
or military commander, of Rome, while the papacy and Roman elite rejected the policy out of hand, the
Liber pontificalis
even taking the unprecedented step of denouncing the emperor as a heretic.
因此，七世纪中叶起，意大利北部和中部的领土，尤其在拉文纳总督区内，似乎逐渐脱离了帝国的直接控制，尽管君士坦丁堡也设法照看当地事务。东部来的官员确实时常往来，不过地方当权者能进入君士坦丁堡并取得首都所能授予的头衔与地位的机会有限。
尽管如此，除少数例外，精英还是大致忠于帝都与皇帝，即使他们在一些关键问题上有自己的主张。新官员与高级军官到任，或皇帝通过总督施行某些帝国政治决定，有时能加强帝国的立场。但如同北非一样，行政机构的统治核心，即总督与其身边的随员，虽常由君士坦丁堡任命，本地人和行省精英却占据了许多高级职位，且主导了所有较低层级，局面因而难免复杂。
名义上的忠诚与主要以行省为中心的政治眼光和立场，可以同时存在。西部军队的回应以及偶尔出现的东方军队，有时足以贯彻较为严格的帝国权威，压下潜在的不忠，如663至668年间就是如此。但意大利离帝国的关注重心实在太远，很难受中央指挥、高耗费的军事干预的严重威胁。如后面将看到的，除西西里，也可能还要算上南部的谷物产区之外，意大利的帝国领土所能提供的收入并不多。

Thus, from the middle of the seventh century, the Italian territories in the north and center, in particular those within the exarchate of Ravenna, seem slowly to have slipped away from direct imperial control in spite of efforts by Constantinople to pay attention to their affairs. Eastern officials certainly came and went regularly, although members of the local establishment had only limited access to Constantinople and the titles and status it could bestow.

Nevertheless, the elite remained, with few exceptions, more or less loyal to the imperial capital and the emperor, even if independent-minded on key issues. The imperial position could be reinforced from time to time by the arrival of new officials and senior officers or the imposition by an emperor through the exarchs of imperial political decisions. But the situation was inevitably complicated by the fact that, as in North Africa, while the leading elements of the administration— the exarch and his immediate entourage— tended to be appointed from Constantinople, it was locals and members of the provincial elite who filled many senior posts and dominated at all lower levels.

Nominal loyalty went hand-in-hand with a largely provincial political perspective and orientation. Again, while the response of western units and the occasional appearance of eastern forces might be sufficient—as in the period 663–668—to impose a stricter imperial authority and stifle any potential disloyalty, Italy was simply too far from the center of imperial attention to be seriously threatened by costly centrally directed military intervention. The income that could be drawn from imperial lands in Italy was not great, with the exception of Sicily and, possibly, the grain-producing areas of the south, as we shall see.
与安纳托利亚大部分地方不同，君士坦丁堡在意大利既不可能始终同样有效地监管地方精英，也不可能投入同样多的现金和军队。但也许更重要的是，意大利没有一个团结一致、可能形成压倒性威胁的敌人。相反，帝国保有的地区由各地日益自主的精英领导，和教会一道面对时而颇为强大、但通常并不团结的敌人。伦巴第王国在北方，斯波莱托和贝内文托两个公国在中部。帝国行政当局与当地伦巴第显贵的关系也经常变动。
在当时的情形下，地方和区域认同蓬勃发展，但无须抛弃对帝国及君士坦丁堡政府的忠诚才能存续。事实上，即使在罗马，当地方自主不断扩大、独立的精英阶层兴起时，也能一边在名义上保持对帝国的忠诚，一边反对帝国宗教政策。
同时，帝国海军也能维持与首都大致不中断的联系，使帝国官员持续往来，至少直到740年代和750年代初，总督区的军事和经济力量被削弱得几乎不复存在时，才有所改变。

Unlike in much of Anatolia, an effective and constant Constantinopolitan oversight over local elites was not possible to the same degree, no more than were injections of cash or of troops. But perhaps more importantly, in Italy there was no potentially overwhelming challenge from a united enemy. Instead, the remaining imperial territories, under their various increasingly autonomous local elites and with the church, faced a generally disunited, even if at times quite powerful, enemy in the form of the Lombard kingdom in the north and the duchies of Spoleto and Benevento in the center, with frequent shifts in the relationship between the imperial administration and local Lombard notables.

Local and regional identities flourished in the conditions of the period, but loyalty to the empire and to the government at Constantinople was not something that needed to be surrendered in order to survive. Indeed, even in Rome it was possible to retain a nominal loyalty to the empire in a period of increasing local autonomy and growth of an independent elite while at the same time opposing imperial religious policy;

at the same time imperial naval forces were able to maintain relatively unbroken communications with the capital as well as a flow of imperial officials, at least until the military and economic strength of the exarchate had been whittled away to almost nothing in the 740s and early 750s.
尽管资料稀少，遥远南部的帝国利益也得以维持，甚至可能比在北部得到更稳妥的维护。一个原因是伯罗奔尼撒的人口迁入，这一过程早在六世纪就已开始。
另一个原因是，这一地区与西西里同为谷物和葡萄酒的重要产地，供应的还不止罗马。西西里的官员似乎比总督区出身的人更容易进入帝国宫廷、更容易在东部任职，这也反映出西西里的重要性。
前面提到，660年代初，君士坦斯二世下令重新核定帝国西部诸地区的税负，其中包括卡拉布里亚，以及西西里、撒丁和阿非利加。
681年，君士坦丁四世颁令，降低西西里与卡拉布里亚的
coemptum frumenti
（每年实缴的谷物税）的核定税率。这意味着君士坦斯为供养他在那里时的宫廷和军队，曾提高这项税率。该地区的气候代用资料确实显示，从四世纪后期至八世纪中叶，当地气候特别温和湿润。因此，只要政府能够稳妥地调取，当地就能成为可靠的谷物来源。

Although information is sparse, imperial interests in the far south were also maintained and were possibly more securely represented than in the north. This was partly because of the immigration of populations from the Peloponnese, a process beginning already in the sixth century,

and partly also because the region was, with Sicily, an important source of both grain and wine, and not just for Rome. This importance is reflected in the fact that Sicilian officials seem to have had greater access to the imperial court and to positions in the east than those from the exarchate.
We noted earlier that Constans II ordered a reassessment of fiscal burdens in the western regions of the empire, including Calabria (along with Sicily, Sardinia, and Africa), in the early 660s;
and in 681 Constantine IV issued orders reducing the rate of assessment of the
coemptum frumenti,

the annual tax in grain, for Sicily and Calabria, implying that Constans had increased it in order to support his court and military during his presence there. Indeed, the proxy climate data for the region show that it enjoyed an especially mild, humid climate regime from the later fourth into the middle of the eighth century, thus rendering it a reliable source of grain so long as the government could draw upon it securely.
从四世纪起，特别是自五世纪起，阿普利亚已经成为谷物的重要产地，后来曾属于东罗马的伦巴第军区（
thema
）。然而，668年君士坦斯二世死后，除加利波利和奥特朗托附近最南端的地方外，该地区实际上脱离了帝国权威，直到九世纪才被收复。
卡拉布里亚（布鲁提乌姆和卢卡尼亚）同样从六世纪上半叶起成为谷物的重要产区，也供应马匹和其他农产品。虽然屡受威胁，仍有相当一部分留在帝国手中。
与伦巴第人的战争持续不断，君士坦斯二世又在当地采取军事行动，因而该地区增修了防御工事，也促成了当地人口和聚落格局的转变。但是，国家与教会密切合作，巩固了帝国及教会的道德权威，也巩固了罗马人的认同。同北部的总督区一样，许多城里居民加入了地方民兵，传统的土地所有者阶层则融入帝国官僚机构，形成一个同时以官职和出身为基础的新的社会精英阶层。
From the fourth and especially the fifth centuries, Apulia (later part of the east Roman military command or
thema

of Langobardia) had already become a major producer of grain but apart from its southernmost districts around Gallipoli and Otranto was effectively lost to imperial authority after the death of Constans II in 668, to be recovered only in the ninth century.

Calabria (Bruttium and Lucania) had likewise become a major producer of cereals from the first half of the sixth century as well as a source of horses and produce, and, while often threatened, a substantial part of it remained in imperial hands.

The fortification of the region as a consequence of the ongoing warfare with the Lombards and especially the military activities of Constans II also contributed to the transformation of the demography and settlement pattern of the region, but state and church operated closely together in reinforcing imperial as well as ecclesiastical moral authority and Roman identity. Just as in the exarchate in the north, many urban residents became part of a local militia while the traditional class of landowners merged with the imperial bureaucracy to generate a new social elite of office and birth.
伦巴第人的侵占缩小了该地区的范围，六世纪后期起人口又严重减少。不过，该地区仍有战略重要性，农业也相对富裕，因此帝国仍有所投入，也继续过问当地事务，虽说投入的规模不大。例如，686/687年，查士丁尼二世减轻了该地区一些教廷庄园的税负。
卡拉布里亚提供谷物、葡萄酒、木材与人力，也是一处重要的矿产来源，尤其出产铜和银，也有金。至少从陶器证据看，当地显然还把产品运销到直接腹地之外。
与伦巴第人的战争所带来的变化相对缓慢，这再次意味着，该地区从未面对叙利亚那种压倒性的征服，尽管战事有时造成相当大的破坏，特别是君士坦斯二世死后，罗马领土再度受袭的时候。
然而，帝国的财政压迫仍然迫使许多普通城乡居民接受伦巴第人的统治，有限的证据也说明了这一点。
但即使在这种压力下，帝国仍在当地存在，也仍关心当地资源。卡拉布里亚同西西里关系密切，经济上同属一个较小的区域，西西里造币厂所铸货币在当地也居于主导地位。加上卡拉布里亚与拉文纳总督区保持联系，且当地精英的利益与帝国利益相合，这些因素确保了当地的忠诚得以维持，尽管逐渐出现了一个半自主的地方精英阶层。这一点有别于北非的情形。

Although considerably reduced in extent by Lombard encroachment and with a population in serious decline from the later sixth century, the continued strategic importance and relative agricultural wealth of the region meant a continued, if small-scale, imperial investment and concern. In 686/687 Justinian II reduced the fiscal burden on some papal estates in the region, for example.

Calabria was a source of grain, wine, wood and manpower as well as, significantly, of minerals, in particular copper and silver, but also of gold. And it also seems clear that it continued to export produce beyond its immediate hinterland, at least so far as the ceramic evidence suggests.

The relatively gradual processes of change that accompanied warfare with the Lombards meant once again that the region was never faced with the sort of overwhelming conquest that took place in Syria, even if warfare caused substantial devastation at times, especially with the renewed attacks on Roman territory after the death of Constans II.
Imperial fiscal oppression nevertheless drove many among the ordinary rural and urban populations to accept Lombard control, as the limited evidence shows.

But even under such pressure, the continued imperial presence and interest in its resources, close association with Sicily (with which it formed economically part of the same subregion, the coinage from the mint of which dominated in the area), contact with the exarchate at Ravenna, and the identity of the interests of the elite with those of the empire ensured a continuing loyalty— again in spite of the evolution of a semi-autonomous local elite—in contrast to the North African situation.

西西里的资源十分重要，所以帝国政府更加关注该岛。六世纪查士丁尼在位时，帝国对西西里实行比较直接的管理，后来仍维持这个做法。和北非相比，其实同意大利半岛本身相比也一样，西西里地方较小，相对容易控制。若按面积衡量，谷物产出极为丰厚。因其是岛屿，帝国海军即便难以防止阿拉伯人袭击，也能保护它免遭伦巴第人攻击，使其经济免受扰乱。在西西里，政府确实格外用力，确保当地精英继续给予支持、保持忠诚。例如约620—641年，政府需要额外的谷物供应时，就特别发行了加盖戳记的钱币。君士坦斯二世驻岛，帝国宫廷与军队的到来无论带来多重的负担，也必然增加了当地精英在社会和政治上升迁的机会。由此不难理解，为什么同其他大多数西部行省不同，西西里直到九世纪第二个十年仍牢牢处于帝国控制之下。拉文纳教会和教廷都在岛上拥有庄园。这两方的利益与君士坦丁堡的利益相结合，确实使这个岛对三方都一直极为重要。
西西里的
strategos
，即军事统帅，在约700年就相当早地见于记载。八、九世纪，留存的西西里军事统帅的印玺，以及关于他们的文字记载，比帝国其他任何一个军区都多。这表明了西西里的经济与战略价值。

The importance of the resources of Sicily meant that the government paid a great deal more attention to the island. It remained under the more direct imperial management that had prevailed since the time of Justinian in the sixth century. It was a smaller and relatively easily controlled region compared with North Africa, for example—or, indeed, with the Italian peninsula itself— and relative to its size was extremely wealthy in terms of grain production. The fact that it was an island and that imperial naval forces could protect it from Lombard attacks, if not from the Arabs, protected it from economic disruption. In Sicily, indeed, the government took particular pains to ensure the continued support and loyalty of the local elite, issuing especially countermarked coins when, in the period ca. 620–641, it required additional supplies of grain, for example; while Constans II’s presence on the island, whatever the burdens the arrival of the imperial court and army brought with them, would certainly have enhanced the possibilities for social and political advancement open to the local elite. In this respect it is not hard to see why Sicily, in contrast to most of the other western provinces, remained firmly under imperial control until the second decade of the ninth century. The church of Ravenna had estates there as well as the papacy, and their interests combined with those of Constantinople certainly made the island of continuing and central importance to all three parties.
The
strategos,

or military commander, of Sicily makes a fairly early appearance, ca. 700, and its economic as well as strategic value is indicated by the fact that there are more seals and references in texts for military commanders of Sicily for the eighth and ninth centuries than for any other single military province of the empire.

帝国能否保住在叙利亚、安纳托利亚、北非和意大利的行省，有着很不相同的历史。这显示了君士坦丁堡政府所面临的难处：如何与不同地区的精英打交道，如何征收现金或实物税赋，以及如何动员人力和物资来保住各地，既抵御内部异议与反抗，也应对外来威胁。显然有些变化影响了所有地区，特别是安纳托利亚精英的军事化。然而，在东方，首都及其周边似乎仍有一个强大的城市精英阶层。两种精英并非截然不同，不过双方眼光和抱负各异，所产生的紧张很可能又促进了社会内部的权力平衡，并让皇帝能够相当牢固地掌控首都里帝国行政的各个方面。无论如何，非常清楚的是，行省精英继续拥护君士坦丁堡，正是帝国能有效抵抗进攻的核心因素。形势和地理条件有利时，强制能够奏效。长期忠诚能否维系，则取决于这些精英与都城和帝国中心的利益能否一致、能否重合，从社会、政治、经济到观念方面都是如此。与北非本地精英的情形不同，政府确实能保持安纳托利亚精英对帝国的忠诚与拥护。与意大利精英的情形不同，安纳托利亚精英从来没有远到足以妨碍政府直接干预，遏止他们反对或从地方抵制帝国政策的地步。而且，与更远地区的精英不同，安纳托利亚人不得不把君士坦丁堡视为地位、特权与财富的直接来源。

The very different histories of the ways in which the empire was or was not able to hold onto its provinces in Syria, Anatolia, North Africa, and Italy illustrate the difficulties the government at Constantinople faced in dealing with the elites of the different regions; in extracting fiscal revenues, whether in cash or in kind; and in mobilizing the resources in manpower and matériel with which to secure them against internal dissent and opposition as well as against external threats. There were clearly some developments that affected all areas, in particular the militarization of the Anatolian elite. Yet it seems that in the east there also remained a powerful civic elite in and around the capital. The two were by no means rigidly distinct, but the tension between their different perspectives and ambitions may well have contributed once again to an internal social balance of power and to the ability of the emperors to maintain a fairly firm hand on all aspects of imperial administration in the capital. In any case it is quite clear that it was the continued adherence of provincial elites to Constantinople that constituted the central element in the ability of the empire effectively to resist attack. Coercion worked, when circumstances and geography favored it. The maintenance of longer-term loyalty depended upon an identity and overlap of interests— social, political, economic, and ideological— between these elites and the metropolitan and imperial center. In contrast to its relationship with the indigenous elite of North Africa, the government was indeed able to maintain the loyalty and adherence to the imperial cause of the Anatolian elites; in contrast to the elites in Italy, those in Anatolia were never distant enough to inhibit direct government intervention to stem opposition or regional resistance to imperial policy. And in contrast to elites in more distant regions, the Anatolians could not but see Constantinople as the direct source of status, privilege, and wealth.

罗马人的认同，无疑意味着每个人都想让自身所处的现状延续下去，用我们的话来说，就是让他们世界的社会、文化和政治结构延续下去。但对他们而言，为国家效力既是为“国家”这个抽象实体或观念尽公职，也至少同样是谋取个人与家族利益的手段，甚至后者更为重要。这一国家观念固然属于精英的象征宇宙，也使他们感到自己享有某些权利，同时负有某些义务与责任。人们追求官职和头衔，这是实现既有利益的一环，尽管在宫廷或行省为皇帝效力，本身就是一项受人敬重、值得称许的成就。

Their identity as Roman undoubtedly entailed a desire on the part of individuals to see the continued existence of the status quo in which they lived (the social, cultural, and political structures of their world, in our terms). But they also saw service for the state as a means to an end— for their own personal and family interests—at least as much as, if not more than, a form of public service to “the state” as an abstract entity or notion. Such a concept was certainly part of the symbolic universe of the elite and brought with it a sense of certain duties and responsibilities as well as rights. Office and title were aspired to as part of the process of realizing vested interests, even if being in the service of the emperor, at court or in the provinces, was in itself an esteemed and praiseworthy attainment.

因此，虽说无从知道安纳托利亚的教会或精英怎样回应帝国的一志论政策，却可以假定，其中多数人选择遵从，因为这依旧符合他们的利益，因为他们仍认同东罗马国家的利益以及它所代表的政治和观念世界。史料中没有关于世俗反抗的记载，无疑暗示了这一点，关于教士反应的证据也指向同一结论。例如，680—681年会议每次会议的签署人名单清楚显示，在帝国政策走向明朗以前，多数人不愿出席。从第十一次会议到最后的第十八次会议，所有已到君士坦丁堡的人都出席了，此时整个主教团显然已表明支持帝国的立场。

So while we have no information about the response to imperial monotheletism of the church or the elite in Anatolia, we may assume that the majority conformed because it remained in their interests to do so, because they still identified with the interests of the east Roman state and the political-ideological world it represented. This is certainly what the absence of references to secular opposition suggests, and it is what the evidence for the response of the clergy suggests. At the council of 680–681, for example, the lists of signatories to each of the sessions clearly show a reluctance on the part of the majority to attend until the direction of imperial policy had become clear, at which point— from the eleventh session until the end (session eighteen)— all those who had reached Constantinople were in attendance, and by which time the whole episcopate had clearly pledged themselves to the imperial position.
决定性的因素是皇帝及其宫廷。后来的一些事例也表明，人们对帝国宗教政策的反应取决于此，例如菲利皮科斯·巴尔达内斯时对一志论的回应，尽管持续时间很短，又如对反圣像政策的回应。
与北非不同，也在较小程度上与意大利和西地中海诸岛不同，650年代之后，东罗马国家几乎所有余下的领土，都在君士坦丁堡能够较直接施加打击的范围内。因此，政府也能迅速而有效地派军进驻，组织统一的防务。互惠因而成为可能。要使它得以实现，一方面须保卫行省精英的既有利益，使他们进入一套赋予社会及文化地位与声望的体系，另一方面还须以他们身为政府官员和军队首领的身份，向他们发放数额可观的现金。

The key determinant was the emperor and court. It is also what later examples of the response to imperial religious policies suggest, as with monotheletism under Philippicus Bardanes (however briefly) or with iconoclasm, for example.

In contrast to North Africa, and to a lesser degree Italy and the islands of the western Mediterranean, virtually all the remaining territories of the east Roman state were, after the 650s, within relatively direct striking distance of Constantinople. The government was therefore also in a position to deliver— quickly and effectively—in terms of a military presence and an organized and coherent defense. Reciprocity was possible, and it was the combination of defense of vested interests, incorporation into a system of social and cultural status and esteem, and injections of substantial cash payments to the provincial elites, in their role as officials of the government and leaders of the army, through which it was achieved.
